description: Essential Dafny assertions: every unlabelled assert of a program whose baseline verifies fully is removed by character range; it is essential when the enclosing declaration then fails (removal: fail, timeout = budget exhausted, wall-timeout = safety net), still fails under a second random seed (removal_seed2) and still fails with the inert 'ghost var placeboTerm := 0;' in its place (placebo). removal_errors are the failing obligations on removal, in source line numbers. In this run the enclosing declaration of a candidate was probed also when another declaration of the same program exhausted the budget on the baseline (programs with baseline 'timeout').
